verification_policy: Single-skill Strike Super research: independently verify Xenoverse 2 identity, acquisition route, cost, mechanics, and CaC availability. Preserve unresolved fields as null.
research_scope: Spirit Stab — Strike Super / Vegito acquisition research.

verification_audit.method: Revalidated against current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation plus independent Xenoverse 2 DLC/update and TP Medal Shop records. The live canonical index was checked; Spirit Stab remains outside the 469-record canonical index and therefore was not promoted without the supported builder/runtime.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Spirit Stab was found. Canonical identity is Super / Strike.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Spirit Stab as a 100-Ki Strike Super used by SSGSS Vegito.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies the TP Medal Shop as the Future Warrior acquisition route. Independent Xenoverse 2 sources corroborate its Super Pack 4 introduction and TP Medal Shop availability after the free update.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because the documented Future Warrior route is the TP Medal Shop rather than a Parallel Quest reward.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The move is documented as a one-bar Ki Super; canonical numeric Ki cost is recorded as 100. Stamina cost remains null.

records.name: Spirit Stab
records.skill_description: Perform a quick thrusting attack with a Ki sword.
records.mechanics_notes: Current Xenoverse 2 evidence describes a long-range, single-hit Ki-blade thrust that re-stands the opponent. The in-game description warns that the move cannot be guarded. The reviewed sources establish the 100-Ki cost and TP Medal Shop route; exact frame, hitbox, damage, and guard-state implementation values are not promoted.
records.acquisition_notes: Spirit Stab was introduced with Super Pack 4 and made available to the Future Warrior through the TP Medal Shop with the relevant update. Independent Xenoverse 2 records corroborate its TP Medal Shop listing. No Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement is established.
records.pve_notes: TP Medal Shop acquisition; no Parallel Quest or Ultimate Finish requirement established.
records.pvp_notes: Long-range single-hit Ki-blade Strike Super with re-stand behavior and documented inability to guard the attack. Exact frame, hitbox, guard-state edge cases, and matchup claims remain version-sensitive.
